podcast.body: This song from the album *Phantom Power* contains lyrics that reference Paul Henderson's famous goal in the 1972 Canada-Russia Series, demonstrating the band's integration of Canadian hockey history into their music. "lines from the song Fireworks from the Phantom Power album that talks about Paul Henderson's famous goal."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song has a background connection to Gord Downie's godfather, Harry Sinden, a Stanley Cup winning coach for the Boston Bruins and head coach for Team Canada in the 1972 series with the Soviets, explaining the hockey references. The song was written about all those games Sinden was involved in. "It also gives you a little bit of a background to the hip song Fireworks, which was written about all those games."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
